notes: «- يعني ابن إبراهيم -» is an editor gloss, left out
«قال سألت عبد الله بن عمر»: Yunus is the asker, Ibn Umar the one asked and answering: his own account is the saying (rule 6)
«تعرف عبد الله بن عمر» and «فإن عبد الله بن عمر طلق» are Ibn Umar's words about himself in the story; not separate links
